    if isinstance(flowable, KeepTogether):

**Hi student, let's get you uncooked.**

[Download the revised sheet](/<ROOT>/outputs/STAT110-final-sheet-r2-readable/stat-110-final-provisional-topic-coverage-v2.pdf)

I replaced the abstract T1/T2 rules and repeated correction with one worked table example, and separated the existing grouped-summary points for easier scanning. No course information was added. The revised layout uses 15 pt body text in two columns and fits on one page.

The layout check found no missing font glyphs. Page previews weren’t available, so I couldn’t inspect the PDF visually.
